(“GetResponse”, “we”, “us”) is the provider of certain online marketing and related services known as the GetResponse Service (the “Service”)."*
* **US / Canada Terms of Service:**
  > *"GetResponse Inc., a Delaware corporation with principal office at 3 Germay Dr Ste, 5 PMB 15672, Wilmington, DE 19804 (“GetResponse”, “we”, “us”) is the provider of certain online marketing and related services known as the GetResponse Service (the “Service”) on the US site https://www.getresponse.com/; and their related marketing channels (the “Site”)."*

GetResponse is recognized for its comprehensive solutions that support personal branding and community engagement.
